label: A first look at Lisbon
name: Free Tour Lisbon: Essential History, Fun Facts and Free Tastings
description: An introduction across Chiado, Baixa and the old city. Choose this if you want context for the rest of your stay.
consideration: It overlaps with parts of Alfama. Compare the stops before booking both walks.
imageAlt: Rua Augusta in the centre of Lisbon

label: Alfama and the old streets
name: The Unmissable Alfama: Secrets of Lisbon’s Oldest District
description: Focus on Alfama and Mouraria, with the cathedral area and viewpoints. A more concentrated look at the older neighbourhoods.
consideration: Expect slopes and uneven paving; check the operator’s accessibility details.
imageAlt: The rooftops of Alfama and the Tagus from Portas do Sol

label: Belém and maritime history
name: Free Tour Age of Discoveries (Belém)
description: A separate riverside walk in Belém, rather than another tour of the city centre. Pair it with the visit you have planned in that area.
consideration: Allow time to reach Belém. Do not assume monument admission is included in the walk.

label: Black history in Lisbon
name: Black History Tour, the forgotten story
description: A walk about African presence, slavery and colonial history in Lisbon. Choose it for a specific historical perspective rather than a general introduction.
consideration: Read the full theme and itinerary before deciding whether it suits your group.

label: Viewpoints and a longer walk
name: Top 8 Panoramic Views — Miradouros
description: A route linking several viewpoints, with more emphasis on walking and city views. Compare its stops with any central tour you have already taken.
consideration: The guide describes a long, hilly route unsuitable for pushchairs. Check the route and finish point carefully.
imageAlt: Alfama rooftops and the Tagus River
